judiciary_art4section5tracker.a_severity: iphaneli ehlelwe ngokwesinga kwezinto ye-{name}, ukubhala kwe-{name2}.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.due_within: kufanele kube khona izinsuku {timeframe_days} emva kokutholwe yinkantolo · {remedy} · Art. IV §5 — imibono ihlala iyikomenti ngomthetho olungisiwe
judiciary_art4section5tracker.enforcemen: Ukuphikelelwa kuhambisana nesimo sokugcina somthetho: olungisiwe, ogcinwe ngokuchitha ukuvimba, noma olungiswe inkantolo. Izenzo zesigungu esiphethe
judiciary_art4section5tracker.executives: Isigungu esiphethe siphethe imiphumela — noma iyiphi indlela exazululayo
judiciary_art4section5tracker.filed_by_a: Ifayilwe: {filed_at} ngu {filed_by_label} — noma ubani ohlala lapha angafayla; akukho mhloli ngaphandle kokuhambisana nendawo yegunya.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.if_the_win: Uma isikhathi sivala kungekho ukulungisa noma ukuchitha ukuvimba, ubulungiswa bufaka isixazululo saso ngqo embhalweni womthetho. Umlando wezinguqulo ugcinwe.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.is_edited_: u-{name} ulungiswa kube ngumbhalo ongenhla; unguqulo olusha lomthetho lushaywa phansi kanti unguqulo lwangaphambilini lugcinwe umlandweni. Unguqulo {version_no} (ngaphambilini: {prior_version_no}) →
judiciary_art4section5tracker.no_constit: Ayikho inselelo yomthethosisekelo evulekile ezindaweni zakho zegunya
judiciary_art4section5tracker.opinions_r: imibono ihlala iyikomenti ngomthetho njengoba ubhalwe noma ulungiswe · Art. IV §5
judiciary_art4section5tracker.override_v: Ukuchitha ukuvimba — amavoti asekelayo abo bonke abasebenzayo
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_a_leg: Indlela A — Isishayamthetho shintsha noma sise susa
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_b_sup: Indlela B — Ukuchitha ukuvimba ngeningi elikhethekile esikhathini sokuvimba
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_c_win: Indlela C — Isikhathi sivala, ubulungiswa bulungisa umthetho
judiciary_art4section5tracker.supermajor: Iningi elikhethekile labo bonke amalungu asebenzayo — hhayi avele abakhona kuphela — liqashwe esikhathini sokuvimba.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_law_st: Umthetho uhlala njengoba ubhalwe; okutholwe yinkantolo, ivoti lokuchitha ukuvimba, nesimo salungu ngalinye kurekhodi lomphakathi.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_legisl: Isishayamthetho sin izinsuku {timeframe_days} zokushintsha noma sise susa umthetho (CLK-12, kufanele kube khona {timeframe_due_on}) nezinsuku {veto_window_days} zokuchitha ukuvimba ({remedy}).
Isishayamthetho shintsha noma sise susa umthetho ngokuhamba komthethosivivinywa ojwayelekile ngaphakathi kwesikhathi senkantolo.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.when_a_cou: Uma inkantolo ikhipha okutholwe yinkantolo ngaphansi kwe-Art. IV §5, lo mlandeli ukhombisa okutholwe yinkantolo, isixazululo esincomo, amawashi ombala wombala (CLK-11 / CLK-12), nezindlela zoxazululo ezintathu ngokuqondile.
judiciary_caselifecycle.back_and_advance: Emuva nakuPhambili kuhamba ngokulandelana — ukulingisa kuphela.
judiciary_jurorscreening.a_panel_judge_f: Ijaji lephaneli lilandelela izimpendulo ozifake isiboniso. Uma kuqinisekiswa ukungqubuzana, uyakhululwa ngaphandle kwesijeziso kanti ukudweba kukhetha omunye ozothatha indawo yakho.
judiciary_jurorscreening.answer_honestly: Phendula ngokuthembeka — ukuhlunga kususa ukungqubuzana kwezifiso, hhayi imibono, izimo zabantu, noma ezepolitiki. Izimpendulo zakho ziya kumajaji ephaneli kuphela.
judiciary_jurorscreening.you_remain_in_t: Usahlala ohlelweni lwephaneli. Ukuqashwa kuqinisekiswa e-voir dire.
